    • parse

      public static Property parse(Class<?> type, String name)
      Selects a property from the specified java class.
      Parameters:
      type - java class whose property is to be selected
      name - name of the property to be selected
      Returns:
      the requested property object or null if there is no property with the specified name on the specified type
